title: 团队资料归档 · 开发者运行图

nodes.label: 负责人发起归档
nodes.summary: 负责人发起归档；程序核对当前资格，执行检查并在提交前再次复核。

nodes.label: 资料条目与内容版本
nodes.summary: 资料条目直接位于一个分类文件夹；归档针对条目的内容版本，不归档文件夹。

nodes.label: 是否直接负责所在文件夹
nodes.summary: 只按资料所在文件夹的直接负责人判断，上级负责人不因祖先关系获得权限。

nodes.label: 审批是否适用
nodes.summary: 审批目标四字段匹配、审批人为另一名审核员、未撤销且未到截止时刻；任一候选有效即可。撤销后重新判断，没有有效审批则等待。

nodes.label: 内容检查
nodes.summary: Check SECRET: against this run's fixed input; capture length, digest, and actual decisions, never body text.

nodes.label: 索引检查
nodes.summary: Verify this run's title, project, and document ID.

nodes.label: 每次运行独享名额
nodes.summary: Each run owns its capacity, chosen as 1 or 2; checks release slots after finishing.

nodes.label: 保存资料版本快照
nodes.summary: 在 SQLite 保存内容的固定快照及对应版本，不移动或删除原资料；同一资料/版本不得重复生成记录。

nodes.label: 撤销审批
nodes.summary: 撤销触发审批重评；有替代有效审批时继续具备审批条件；否则等待。已启动检查完成且保留结果，不提交。

nodes.label: 修改资料内容
nodes.summary: Old runs cannot commit; pending checks are discarded, active checks finish, and the new version has a separate run.

nodes.label: 当前文件夹的直接负责人
nodes.summary: 只读取该项目、该文件夹的直接负责关系，不读取祖先作为继承授权。

nodes.label: 项目 · 操作人 · 资料 · 版本
nodes.summary: 单条审批的四个目标字段必须全部匹配本次请求。

nodes.label: 该资料版本是否已有归档
nodes.summary: 重复请求不能生成第二条同资料同版本的记录。

nodes.label: 点击继续并重查资格
nodes.summary: 审批条件恢复后手动继续，重查当前资格；已完成同版本检查结果保留。

nodes.label: 运行身份与内容版本
nodes.summary: 每次运行独立保留活动和结果；旧新版本运行可同时查询，新运行不覆盖仍在结束的旧运行。

nodes.label: Check archive eligibility
nodes.summary: Current direct ownership, valid approval, and body size conditions hold.

nodes.label: Complete both checks for this run
nodes.summary: Each run owns its slots; retain individual activities and resource state.

nodes.label: Recheck and persist snapshot
nodes.summary: In one transaction, verify current relationships, version, approvals, size limit, and this run's checks.

nodes.label: Read current authoritative relationships
nodes.summary: Read the document, direct owner, and full approval candidates in one SQLite transaction.

nodes.label: Evaluate each approval
nodes.summary: Independently evaluate each approval's target, identity, revocation, and expiry conditions.

nodes.label: Is the actor still eligible?
nodes.summary: Reread current version and relationships before commit; do not reuse an earlier success.

nodes.label: Both checks passed for this run
nodes.summary: The ALL join uses results from the same run and content version only.

nodes.label: Cancel this run
nodes.summary: Prevent pending checks from starting; active checks release slots only after actual completion.

nodes.label: This run's phase
nodes.summary: Expand actual state transitions; historical frames use their recorded state.

nodes.label: Approve the current version
nodes.summary: Record another reviewer's version-bound approval; existing waiting runs still need manual continuation.

nodes.label: Change classification folder
nodes.summary: Update the folder and relationship revision, then recheck direct ownership.

nodes.label: Recover interrupted records
nodes.summary: Restart does not revive lost workers; preserve records and release their capacity.

nodes.label: Execute and persist check results
nodes.summary: Update the same run after the real worker finishes, then release its slot.

nodes.label: Project archive size limit
nodes.summary: Persist per project, default 8192 bytes; changing it does not change content versions or approvals.

nodes.label: Is the body within the current limit?
nodes.summary: Count body UTF-8 bytes only; equality is allowed; reread the limit at start, resume, and commit.

nodes.label: Change project size limit
nodes.summary: Accept positive integers only; oversized runs wait, active checks finish, and recovery requires manual continuation.
